# FuboTV: It's Just FuboTV

A FuboTV hockey player skates toward the camera, delivers a deal line, and finishes with a hard stop that sprays ice before skating away.

## Panel 1 — FuboTV Hockey Stop
Image: The setting is a modern indoor hockey arena at night, a white ice rink with FuboTV boards and digital banners, bright overhead floodlights, and cheering fans filling the stands. FuboTV hockey player is a man in his late twenties, athletic build, light skin, short brown hair, wearing a reddish-orange and white hockey jersey with a large FuboTV logo on the front, white pants, black skates, and a white helmet. A hockey player stands center ice facing the camera, body angled slightly forward, arms relaxed at his sides, mouth open mid-speech. The rink boards behind him carry bold FuboTV logos, and digital banners on the bleachers repeat the FuboTV name above a blurred cheering crowd. Cool white ice fills the foreground, with soft overhead arena lighting and a reddish-orange, white, and blue color palette. The camera sits low at ice level, framing the player from the waist up in a medium shot, rendered in a realistic cinematic promo style with shallow depth of field. FuboTV hockey player faces the camera. The shot is a medium shot.
Motion: The FuboTV hockey player skates toward the camera, stops short, and kicks up a spray of ice mist. He then skates away from the camera. FuboTV hockey player faces the camera. The camera tracks alongside the movement.
Dialogue: FuboTV hockey player: Getting the best deal on hockey isn't a hat trick... It's just FuboTV.
